claims.claim: The Ellsworth Falls Village Council has five members: Adaeze Okonkwo, Minh Tran, Rosa Delgado, Gareth Pryce, and Carla Bianchi.
The council's regular session is scheduled for Tuesday 8 September 2026 at 7:00 PM at the village hall, and the published agenda lists final action on Ordinance 2026-14, the Riverwalk Overlay.
The village charter sets quorum at three members and provides that adopting an ordinance requires the affirmative vote of at least three members of the full five-member council.
Council rules require members to be physically present in the chamber to vote, and there is no remote-participation provision.
Okonkwo sponsored Ordinance 2026-14, stated at the 25 August work session that she supports it, and told the clerk she wants final action taken at the 8 September session.
Tran stated at the 25 August work session that he is prepared to vote for Ordinance 2026-14 as drafted.
Delgado told the Ellsworth Falls Courier on 27 August that she opposes Ordinance 2026-14 and intends to vote against it.
Pryce wrote in his 1 September constituent newsletter that he opposes Ordinance 2026-14 in its current form and intends to vote against it.
Bianchi co-sponsored Ordinance 2026-14 and has publicly supported it since June.
Bianchi filed written notice with the village clerk on 2 September that she is absent from the 8 September session to attend her daughter's naval academy induction in Annapolis that evening.
Under council rules an item listed for final action is voted on at that session unless its sponsor moves postponement.
